**What you did**

**What you expected**

**What happened**

**If it was the agent** — paste the turn: the sentence you typed, what it
proposed, and (if you have Phoenix running) the trace id. The two numbers that
matter most are how many candidates were presented and how many suggestions
were discarded as invented.

**If it was the catalogue or a crawler** — paste the raw payload for one
product, not a description of it. One object says more than a paragraph.

**Environment** — OS, Python version, whether a model is running locally and
which one. Say if you are running against a shop other than knuspr.de.

Please do not paste real household data: orders, receipts, names, addresses.
